summary: The seven use cases describe a coherent MVP and the activity graphs are structurally connected, but the requirements baseline has three blocking end-to-end ambiguities: approved content has no defined publication path, geofence behavior conflicts with playback behavior, and notification navigation lacks an explicit content-loading handoff. Resolve those boundaries and the limited diagram/documentation defects before treating the PRD as the implementation baseline; no product redesign or new mandatory user-facing flow is required.

important_issues.title: Approved-content publication and offline package boundary are unowned
important_issues.evidence: UC-02 exposes only APPROVED content, while UC-06 saves only DRAFT or PENDING_REVIEW and explicitly excludes approval, publishing, and mobile synchronization. UC-04 does not say updates contain approved assets only.
important_issues.minimal_resolution: Document an external approval/publication dependency with an owner. Define that only an approved, atomic content/package version is published and installed; UC-02/UC-03 and UC-04 must exclude DRAFT and PENDING_REVIEW data.

important_issues.title: Geofence-to-playback behavior is contradictory
important_issues.evidence: UC-03 and its diagram say playback can be triggered by UC-05, but UC-05 states that notification selection only opens Location Details and leaves content loading/playback to UC-02/UC-03.
important_issues.minimal_resolution: Keep the stated MVP boundary: notification/banner selection opens Location Details only. Remove the UC-05 trigger claim from UC-03 and its diagram; do not introduce include/extend or auto-play.

important_issues.title: Notification navigation has no explicit UC-02 handoff
important_issues.evidence: UC-02 requires a location selected through UC-01, whereas UC-05 independently opens Location Details with locationId and says UC-02 owns content loading.
important_issues.minimal_resolution: Generalize UC-02 to start after any valid navigation to Location Details with locationId, and state that UC-05 notification selection supplies that handoff.

important_issues.title: UC-02 activity can imply loading unapproved content and has incomplete fallback ordering
important_issues.evidence: The activity loads scriptText before the Approved-content decision and does not visibly model Selected Language -> EN -> VI with all successful branches joining before load/display.
important_issues.minimal_resolution: Move the approval decision immediately after lookup. Model the ordered language checks, then merge only approved success paths before Load and Display scriptText.

important_issues.title: UC-03 has unsafe/incomplete pause paths
important_issues.evidence: Remain paused has no outgoing edge or final node; the output-device-disconnect path can loop directly back to playback although UC-03 E3 requires automatic pause to avoid unintended speaker playback.
important_issues.minimal_resolution: Connect Remain paused to the final node and remove the disconnect-to-playback loop. Resume only after an explicit focus-restored or later user-driven action.

important_issues.title: Offline baseline and approved-version consistency are underspecified
important_issues.evidence: UC-01 requires a prior offline download for the local database, while UC-04 says bundled base content enables offline operation without prior download. UC-04 versions packages but UC-06 protects approved revisions without defining package/content-version pairing.
important_issues.minimal_resolution: Choose one first-run offline baseline. Add a short approved package-version contract that installs matched script/audio assets atomically.

minor_issues.title: Activity diagrams omit or serialize documented alternatives
minor_issues.details: Add UC-01 radius expansion; UC-04 delete-cancellation; an end/return after UC-07 empty state; UC-06 approved-version preservation. Model UC-07 period, feedback, status update, and export as independent optional paths; use an event/loop region for UC-03 playback controls.

minor_issues.title: Role and identifier terminology is inconsistent
minor_issues.details: Use Tourist, Content Admin / Editor, and System Admin / Product Owner consistently. Normalize UC-01..UC-07, activity names, locally reset flow steps, and scoped business-rule IDs.

minor_issues.title: PRD and README need editorial/traceability cleanup
minor_issues.details: Correct the PRD title and headings, separate metadata from flow tables, repair UC-03 formatting, define a short glossary, replace authoring placeholders with artifact references, and align README scope/link with the Markdown PRD.

minor_issues.title: Language, feedback, and analytics sources are assumed rather than traced
minor_issues.details: Document the existing/external owner for application language setting, feedback submission, and mobile analytics-event capture; this can remain outside the seven MVP use cases.

cross_agent_agreement: Business, UML, consistency, and documentation reviews all identify the missing APPROVED publication path as the principal lifecycle gap.
Business, UML, and consistency reviews agree that UC-03/UC-05 contradict one another; the written UC-05 MVP boundary supports notification-to-details only.
UML and XML reviews agree that UC-02 needs approval/fallback-flow repair and that UC-03 pause/device-disconnect behavior needs diagram correction.
Business and consistency reviews agree that the offline baseline must be stated consistently across UC-01 and UC-04.

conflicting_findings.topic: Required scope for approval, feedback, language, and analytics capture
conflicting_findings.resolution: Do not add new MVP user-facing use cases. Record each as an explicitly owned external dependency or future requirement with its input/output contract; only approval/publication needs a release-blocking contract because current UC-02 cannot legally obtain its required content otherwise.
Do not add <<include>> or <<extend>>. UC-01/UC-02/UC-03 handoffs are state/data preconditions, not mandatory reusable user goals; add a system boundary and clear textual handoffs instead.

recommended_minimal_changes: Add one PRD dependency note defining approval -> publication -> approved atomic package/version -> mobile synchronization; name its owner and approved-only rule.
Align UC-03 and UC-05 to notification/banner -> Location Details only; explicitly invoke UC-02 after valid Location Details navigation with locationId.
Repair UC2 and UC3 activity paths before any visual polish: approval before script load, ordered fallback; final paused outcome, no disconnect auto-resume.
Choose the bundled-base versus prior-download offline baseline and state the associated location-database availability.
Normalize roles, IDs, flow/rule numbering, PRD tables/title, diagram references, and README link/scope.

use_cases_needing_revision.reason: Approval/fallback ordering and generalized Location Details handoff.
Remove UC-05 trigger; correct paused/disconnect behavior.
Declare handoff to UC-02 after notification navigation.
Approved-only atomic package/version and baseline alignment; show deletion cancellation.
Trace approval/publication dependency and show approved-version protection.
Align offline baseline and show radius expansion.
Independent optional flows, empty-state route, and external feedback/event traceability.

files_needing_revision.changes: Resolve lifecycle/handoff/offline contracts, normalize identifiers/roles/tables/rules, and correct editorial defects.
Correct UC2/UC3 paths, add omitted compact alternatives, align labels and use-case notes, and add system boundaries to use-case diagrams.
Align product scope and authoritative PRD link; remove stale placeholders and incomplete formatting.

optimized_activity_flows.UC-02: Location Details(locationId) -> resolve selected language and mode -> lookup approved content -> selected language available? load; otherwise EN available? load; otherwise VI available? load; otherwise show updating/unavailable and disable Listen -> display scriptText.
optimized_activity_flows.UC-03: Tourist selects Play -> matching approved audio available/playable? play audio : TTS(scriptText) -> Playing -> compact event loop for pause/resume/seek/speed and focus interruption -> focus restored? resume : remain paused -> final. Device disconnect -> pause/save position -> final.
optimized_activity_flows.UC-04: Open manager -> choose update or delete. Update: newer approved package? no -> unchanged/final; yes -> confirm -> storage? -> download -> verify -> atomically replace with approved package/version -> ready. Cancel/failure -> current content unchanged/final. Delete: confirm? yes -> delete optional only -> status/final; no -> unchanged/final.
optimized_activity_flows.UC-05: Enter geofence -> resolve nearest valid location -> cooldown/permission/foreground checks -> notification or banner(locationId, resolved language) -> selected? no -> final; yes -> Location Details(locationId) -> UC-02 content loading.
optimized_activity_flows.UC-06: Open form -> create/edit -> validate/upload/preview -> save draft or submit review. On edit of approved content: retain published approved version and save replacement as PENDING_REVIEW -> final.
optimized_activity_flows.UC-07: Open dashboard -> load selected period -> show analytics or empty state -> optional loop: change period; optional feedback list/filter/select/update; optional export current report with retry on failure -> final. Empty analytics must not force feedback selection.

final_notes: XML structural integrity is good: all seven activity graphs have logical start-to-end paths, no broken edge references, and no logical disconnected nodes. The remaining work is semantic alignment and documentation hygiene, not a redraw from scratch.
